environment: Vitest 5.0.4 / jsdom / real React / official raft-ui ToastProvider and native generated swipe hook
checks: synthetic touch pointer sequence -> native gesture -> real React unmount -> official toast Undo -> row restored without request
pointercancel retains row and sends no request
official toast dismiss -> request once; unmount does not repeat
React rerender with new frontier cancels pending request
limits: Harness uses an isolated row, not the entire production ActivityMessageRow/page.
Geometry and matchMedia are supplied by fixture; no CSS layout or physical pointer verification.
No physical iOS/Android, edge-back competition, haptics or background network-delivery proof.
